title: Policija u Batumiju uzela navijaču Bešiktaša zastavu Palestine
Police in Batumi took a Palestinian flag from a Beşiktaş fan
body: Gruzijska policija ušla je na tribinu stadiona u Batumiju prije utakmice Evropske lige.
Georgian police entered the stand of the stadium in Batumi before a Europa League match.
Jedan navijač Bešiktaša razvio je zastavu Palestine, a nakon toga je došlo do kratkog sukoba.
A Beşiktaš fan unfurled a Palestinian flag, and after that there was a short clash.
Bešiktaš je igrao protiv izraelskog kluba Hapoel Beer Sheva u petom kolu.
Beşiktaš played against the Israeli club Hapoel Beer Sheva in the fifth round.
Video s tribine brzo se proširio na društvenim mrežama.
A video from the stand quickly spread on social networks.
Na snimku se vidi kako policajci ulaze među navijače, a onda počinje guranje.
The recording shows police officers going in among the fans, and then pushing begins.
Turski listovi Milliyet i Akşam pišu da je policija navijaču uzela zastavu.
The Turkish papers Milliyet and Akşam write that the police took the flag from the fan.
Utakmica se igra u Gruziji jer turske vlasti kažu da u Istanbulu ne bi bila sigurna.
The match is being played in Georgia because the Turkish authorities say that it would not be safe in Istanbul.
UEFA je zato izabrala stadion u Batumiju, a utakmica je počela u 18:45.
UEFA therefore chose the stadium in Batumi, and the match started at 18:45.
Navijači su smjeli doći na stadion.
Fans were allowed to come to the stadium.

title: Zašto teže spavamo u tuđoj kući i kako to promijeniti
Why we sleep worse in someone else's house and how to change it
body: Mnogi ljudi teško zaspu kada su u gostima kod porodice ili prijatelja, posebno za praznike.
Many people find it hard to fall asleep when they are guests at family's or friends' homes, especially over the holidays.
Stručnjaci za spavanje kažu da mozak u nepoznatom prostoru ostaje na oprezu.
Sleep experts say that the brain stays on alert in an unfamiliar space.
Magazin Real Simple zato je objavio nekoliko korisnih savjeta.
The magazine Real Simple therefore published several useful tips.
Prvo treba razgovarati s domaćinom o tome kada svi idu spavati.
First you should talk with the host about when everyone goes to sleep.
Dobro je odmah pronaći kupatilo i prekidače za svjetlo, jer se tako mozak lakše smiri.
It is good to find the bathroom and light switches right away, because that way the brain calms down more easily.
Ako možete, ponesite svoj jastuk, a sobu napravite što tamnijom.
If you can, bring your own pillow, and make the room as dark as possible.
Soba bi trebala biti hladnija, a dobra temperatura je oko 18 stepeni.
The room should be cooler, and a good temperature is about 18 degrees.
Stručnjaci savjetuju i da sat prije spavanja smanjite svjetlo i čitate.
Experts also advise that an hour before sleep you dim the light and read.
Poznati mirisi, na primjer vaš gel za tuširanje, također mogu pomoći.
Familiar smells, for example your shower gel, can also help.
Najvažnije je da ne pritiskate sebe, jer nekoliko loših noći nije velik problem.
The most important thing is not to pressure yourself, because a few bad nights are not a big problem.

title: Radomir Saičić bit će kandidat studenata za predsjednika Srbije
Radomir Saičić will be the students' candidate for president of Serbia
body: Studentski plenumi odlučili su da Radomir Saičić bude kandidat Studentske liste za predsjednika Srbije.
Student plenums decided that Radomir Saičić should be the Student List's candidate for president of Serbia.
Predsjednički izbori u Srbiji bit će održani 27. decembra.
The presidential election in Serbia will be held on 27 December.
Predsjednik parlamenta Aleksandar Čupić danas je raspisao te prijevremene izbore.
The speaker of parliament Aleksandar Čupić today called this early election.
Plenumi su dobili samo jedan prijedlog, a to je bilo Saičićevo ime.
The plenums received only one proposal, and that was Saičić's name.
Ranije se spominjala i jedna žena, ali ona nije htjela biti kandidatkinja.
Earlier one woman had also been mentioned, but she did not want to be the candidate.
Studentska lista će ime službeno objaviti u petak, 27. novembra.
The Student List will officially announce the name on Friday, 27 November.
U nedjelju počinje skupljanje potpisa za njegovu kandidaturu.
On Sunday the collection of signatures for his candidacy begins.
Saičić je profesor na Hemijskom fakultetu u Beogradu i član Srpske akademije nauka i umjetnosti.
Saičić is a professor at the Faculty of Chemistry in Belgrade and a member of the Serbian Academy of Sciences and Arts.
Bio je kandidat Studentske liste i na parlamentarnim izborima, kada je 25. oktobra proglasio pobjedu liste.
He was also the Student List's candidate in the parliamentary election, when he declared the list's victory on 25 October.
Politolog Stefan Surlić rekao je da je Saičić ozbiljan kandidat za predsjednika.
Political scientist Stefan Surlić said that Saičić is a serious candidate for president.

title: Advokati kažu da Mustafići nisu dio kriminalne grupe
Lawyers say the Mustafićs are not part of a criminal group
body: Advokati Mesuda i Mustafe Mustafića rekli su za Klix.ba da njihovi klijenti negiraju sve optužbe.
The lawyers of Mesud and Mustafa Mustafić told Klix.ba that their clients deny all the charges.
Oni su uhapšeni u akciji „Emisar“, zajedno s Naserom Orićem, Nikolinom Šljivić i Sinišom Dergancem.
They were arrested in the operation "Emisar", together with Naser Orić, Nikolina Šljivić and Siniša Derganc.
Tužilaštvo Republike Srpske traži pritvor za svih pet osumnjičenih.
The Prosecutor's Office of Republika Srpska is seeking custody for all five suspects.
Tužilaštvo tvrdi da je Orić organizovao grupu koja je trebala pomoći Đorđu Ždrali i Daliboru Bartuli da pobjegnu.
The prosecution claims that Orić organised a group that was supposed to help Đorđe Ždrale and Dalibor Bartula escape.
Mustafići su osumnjičeni za udruživanje u kriminalnu grupu i za pomaganje u pokušaju ubistva.
The Mustafićs are suspected of joining a criminal group and of helping in an attempted murder.
Tužilaštvo kaže da bi mogli pobjeći ili uticati na svjedoke.
The prosecution says that they could escape or influence witnesses.
Advokati Abdulah Kešan i Anel Ibeljić rekli su da njihovi klijenti nikada nisu bili osuđeni.
The lawyers Abdulah Kešan and Anel Ibeljić said that their clients have never been convicted.
Mustafa ima 18 godina i učenik je srednje škole, a obojica žive na stalnoj adresi.
Mustafa is 18 years old and a secondary school student, and both live at a permanent address.
Advokati smatraju da za pritvor nema razloga i da bi bile dovoljne blaže mjere.
The lawyers believe that there is no reason for custody and that milder measures would be enough.
Ročište je bilo zatvoreno za javnost, a sud još nije donio odluku.
The hearing was closed to the public, and the court has not yet made a decision.

title: Klix Vremeplov dobio 23.000 starih vijesti i osmanske novine
Klix Vremeplov gets 23,000 old news stories and Ottoman newspapers
body: Arhiv starih novina Klix Vremeplov danas je dobio sedam novih novina i više od 23.000 vijesti.
The archive of old newspapers Klix Vremeplov today got seven new newspapers and more than 23,000 news stories.
Sada u arhivu ima 25 novina, a čitaoci mogu tražiti tekstove po riječi, datumu, mjestu i novinama.
There are now 25 newspapers in the archive, and readers can search texts by word, date, place and newspaper.
Sav materijal dolazi iz digitalne zbirke Nacionalne i univerzitetske biblioteke BiH.
All the material comes from the digital collection of the National and University Library of BiH.
Prvi put u arhivu su i novine na osmanskom turskom jeziku, pisane arapskim pismom.
For the first time, the archive also has newspapers in the Ottoman Turkish language, written in Arabic script.
To su sarajevske novine Vatan i Rehber, a tekstove je prevela umjetna inteligencija.
These are the Sarajevo newspapers Vatan and Rehber, and the texts were translated by artificial intelligence.
Vatan je izlazio svakog petka od 1884. do 1897. godine, i u arhiv je ušlo svih 640 brojeva.
Vatan came out every Friday from 1884 to 1897, and all 640 issues went into the archive.
Prijevode nije provjerio stručnjak, zato je originalni tekst uvijek najvažniji.
The translations were not checked by an expert, so the original text is always the most important.
Vatan je pisao i o gradnji sarajevske Vijećnice.
Vatan also wrote about the building of the Sarajevo City Hall.
Gradsko vijeće je 1891. godine odlučilo da gradi novu zgradu, a ona je na kraju koštala 500.000 forinti.
The city council decided in 1891 to build a new building, and in the end it cost 500,000 forints.
Novine su pisale i o prvom tramvaju, novoj katedrali i željeznici od Sarajeva do Konjica.
The newspaper also wrote about the first tram, the new cathedral and the railway from Sarajevo to Konjic.
Prema popisu iz 1885. godine, Sarajevo je tada imalo 27.124 stanovnika.
According to a census from 1885, Sarajevo then had 27,124 inhabitants.

title: Vučić: Zvezda i Partizan više neće dobijati državni novac
Vučić: Zvezda and Partizan will no longer get state money
body: Bivši predsjednik Srbije Aleksandar Vučić rekao je da Crvena zvezda i Partizan više neće dobijati novac od države.
Former Serbian president Aleksandar Vučić said that Crvena zvezda and Partizan will no longer get money from the state.
To je izjavio na Informer TV-u, nakon promjene vlasti u Srbiji.
He said this on Informer TV, after the change of government in Serbia.
Vučić je sada šef poslaničke grupe „Srbija pobeđuje“ u parlamentu.
Vučić is now head of the parliamentary group "Srbija pobeđuje" in parliament.
Studentska lista je pobijedila na parlamentarnim izborima, pa se očekuju promjene u finansiranju sportskih klubova.
The Student List won the parliamentary elections, so changes are expected in the funding of sports clubs.
Najveće promjene mogle bi pogoditi košarkaške klubove Zvezde i Partizana.
The biggest changes could hit the basketball clubs of Zvezda and Partizan.
Vučić je rekao da će od iduće godine klubovi imati velikih problema s novcem.
Vučić said that from next year the clubs will have big problems with money.
Priznao je da su klubovi dobijali više novca nego što su zaslužili svojim rezultatima.
He admitted that the clubs got more money than they had earned with their results.
Ipak je rekao da mu nije žao, jer je to bila dobra promocija zemlje.
Still, he said that he is not sorry, because it was good promotion for the country.
Dodao je da je on kriv što ih je razmazio, a da su kritike studenata u tome bile tačne.
He added that he is to blame for spoiling them, and that the students' criticism was correct on this.

title: Dodik oštro kritikovao rezoluciju Evropskog parlamenta o Vukovaru
Dodik sharply criticised the European Parliament's resolution on Vukovar
body: Evropski parlament je danas usvojio rezoluciju o Vukovaru.
The European Parliament today adopted a resolution on Vukovar.
Lider SNSD-a Milorad Dodik ubrzo je na mreži X oštro kritikovao taj dokument.
SNSD leader Milorad Dodik soon sharply criticised that document on the network X.
Rekao je da rezolucija mijenja historiju i da je dio politike protiv Srba.
He said that the resolution changes history and that it is part of a policy against Serbs.
Rezolucija između ostalog traži od Srbije da otvori svoje arhive.
Among other things, the resolution asks Serbia to open its archives.
Tako bi se moglo saznati šta se desilo s 1.725 nestalih osoba.
That way it could be found out what happened to 1,725 missing persons.
Vukovar je pao 18. novembra 1991. godine, nakon tri mjeseca opsade JNA i srpskih paravojnih jedinica.
Vukovar fell on 18 November 1991, after a three-month siege by the JNA and Serb paramilitary units.
Nakon toga su na Ovčari ubijeni zarobljenici i ranjenici iz vukovarske bolnice.
After that, prisoners and wounded people from the Vukovar hospital were killed at Ovčara.
Dodik je zločin u Vukovaru nazvao „jednom epizodom rata“.
Dodik called the crime in Vukovar "one episode of the war".
Pitao je zašto parlament nije donio rezoluciju o Jasenovcu i o srpskim izbjeglicama.
He asked why the parliament had not passed a resolution on Jasenovac and on Serb refugees.
Hrvate je optužio za genocid, a Nijemce je nazvao njihovim „mentorima“.
He accused Croats of genocide, and he called the Germans their "mentors".
Na kraju je rekao da Srbi više neće šutjeti.
At the end he said that Serbs will no longer stay silent.

title: Privrednici u Splitu skupili novac za koncert Dine Merlina
Businesspeople in Split raised money for a Dino Merlin concert
body: Ugostitelji i privrednici iz Splita skupili su više od 70 posto novca za koncert Dine Merlina.
Restaurant owners and businesspeople from Split have raised more than 70 percent of the money for a Dino Merlin concert.
Koncert bi trebao biti održan 30. decembra na splitskoj Rivi.
The concert is supposed to be held on 30 December on Split's Riva.
Honorar za pjevača je plaćen, ali još nedostaje novac za produkciju.
The singer's fee has been paid, but money for the production is still missing.
Organizatori nisu rekli koliko su novca skupili ni koliko im ukupno treba.
The organisers did not say how much money they have raised or how much they need in total.
Ljudi uplaćuju novac preko platforme Adriaticket, a imena donatora bit će objavljena.
People pay the money through the Adriaticket platform, and the names of the donors will be published.
Akciji su se pridružili i hotelijeri, a koncert bi trebao imati i humanitarni dio.
Hotel owners have also joined the campaign, and the concert is supposed to have a charity part as well.
Akcija je počela nakon što je gradonačelnik Splita Tomislav Šuta odustao od ugovora za koncert.
The campaign started after Split mayor Tomislav Šuta withdrew from the contract for the concert.
Više od 20.000 građana potpisalo je peticiju da se novac da za novi medicinski aparat za bolnicu.
More than 20,000 citizens signed a petition for the money to be given for a new medical device for the hospital.
Grad je ranije rekao da bi honorar bio 140.000 eura, a produkcija 160.000 eura.
The city had earlier said that the fee would be 140,000 euros and the production 160,000 euros.
Tim Dine Merlina još nije komentarisao akciju.
Dino Merlin's team has not yet commented on the campaign.

title: WhatsApp uvodi zakazivanje poruka za sve korisnike
WhatsApp introduces message scheduling for all users
body: WhatsApp je zvanično uveo zakazivanje poruka, funkciju koju korisnici često traže.
WhatsApp has officially introduced message scheduling, a feature that users often ask for.
Zakazivanje znači da poruku napišete sada, a ona bude poslana kasnije.
Scheduling means that you write a message now, and it is sent later.
Do sada je funkcija bila dostupna samo nekim korisnicima Android aplikacije, a u narednim sedmicama dobit će je svi.
Until now the feature was available only to some users of the Android app, and in the coming weeks everyone will get it.
Korisnik treba držati dugme za slanje, a onda izabrati datum i vrijeme.
The user needs to hold the send button and then choose a date and time.
Poruke se mogu zakazati najmanje 10 minuta i najviše 14 dana unaprijed.
Messages can be scheduled at least 10 minutes and at most 14 days in advance.
Tako se mogu slati tekst, fotografije i video, u privatnim i grupnim razgovorima.
Text, photos and video can be sent this way, in private and group chats.
Osoba koja dobije poruku ne vidi da je poruka bila zakazana.
The person who receives the message does not see that the message was scheduled.
Prema WhatsAppu, poruka će otići u pravo vrijeme čak i ako je telefon ugašen.
According to WhatsApp, the message will go at the right time even if the phone is switched off.
Korisnici mogu vidjeti sve zakazane poruke i obrisati ih prije slanja.
Users can see all scheduled messages and delete them before sending.
Kompanija kaže da su poruke zaštićene i da ih ona ne može čitati.
The company says that the messages are protected and that it cannot read them.

title: Poništen tender FUP-a od 4 miliona KM za popravku helikoptera
FUP's 4 million KM tender for a helicopter repair cancelled
body: Federalna uprava policije (FUP) poništila je tender za remont, odnosno veliki servis, jednog helikoptera.
The Federal Police Administration (FUP) cancelled a tender for the overhaul, that is, a major service, of one helicopter.
Riječ je o helikopteru Bell 206L-1 Long Ranger.
It is a Bell 206L-1 Long Ranger helicopter.
Obavijest o tome objavljena je danas.
The notice about it was published today.
Tender je poništen 11. novembra, nakon odluke Ureda za razmatranje žalbi.
The tender was cancelled on 11 November, after a decision by the Procurement Review Office.
U obavijesti ne piše ko je uložio žalbu niti zašto je ona prihvaćena.
The notice does not say who filed the appeal or why it was accepted.
Tender je raspisan 24. augusta, a vrijedio je oko 4 miliona KM s PDV-om.
The tender was announced on 24 August, and it was worth about 4 million KM with VAT.
FUP je htio potpisati ugovor na 36 mjeseci s firmom koja ponudi najnižu cijenu.
FUP wanted to sign a 36-month contract with the company that offered the lowest price.
Helikopter je vraćen u BiH iz Srbije 2010. godine.
The helicopter was returned to BiH from Serbia in 2010.
Vlada FBiH dala ga je FUP-u na korištenje 2017. godine.
The FBiH government gave it to FUP for use in 2017.
Od povratka stoji u hangaru, a nije poznato hoće li FUP raspisati novi tender.
Since its return it has been standing in a hangar, and it is not known whether FUP will announce a new tender.

title: Sudiju optužili da je pijan, a njemu je pao šećer
Referee accused of being drunk, but his blood sugar had dropped
body: Sirijski sudija Hanna Hattab zamijenjen je na poluvremenu utakmice azijske Lige prvaka 2.
Syrian referee Hanna Hattab was replaced at half-time of an Asian Champions League 2 match.
Igrali su Al Jazira iz Emirata i iranski klub Gol Gohar.
Al Jazira from the Emirates and the Iranian club Gol Gohar were playing.
Iranski klub je tvrdio da je sudija bio pijan.
The Iranian club claimed that the referee was drunk.
U 32. minuti Hattab je dao žuti karton golmanu Al Jazire, iako golman nije učestvovao u faulu.
In the 32nd minute Hattab gave a yellow card to the Al Jazira goalkeeper, although the goalkeeper had not taken part in the foul.
Odluku je promijenio tek nakon razgovora s četvrtim sudijom.
He changed the decision only after talking to the fourth official.
Gol Gohar je prijetio da neće nastaviti utakmicu ako Hattab ostane, pa je u drugom poluvremenu sudio četvrti sudija.
Gol Gohar threatened not to continue the match if Hattab stayed, so the fourth official refereed the second half.
Snimci s utakmice brzo su se proširili društvenim mrežama.
Videos from the match quickly spread on social networks.
Iranski novinar Erfan Hoseiny sada tvrdi da je sudiji pao šećer u krvi, pa je izgubio koncentraciju.
Iranian journalist Erfan Hoseiny now claims that the referee's blood sugar dropped, so he lost concentration.
Rekao je da je ljekarski pregled nakon utakmice pokazao da alkohola nije bilo.
He said that a medical check after the match showed there was no alcohol.
Azijska nogometna konfederacija (AFC) još nije dala izjavu.
The Asian Football Confederation (AFC) has not yet made a statement.

title: Helez opet pomjerio rok za turske dronove, sada do Nove godine
Helez moves the deadline for Turkish drones again, now by New Year
body: Ministar odbrane BiH Zukan Helez rekao je da bi turski dronovi Bayraktar TB2 trebali stići do Nove godine.
BiH Defence Minister Zukan Helez said that the Turkish Bayraktar TB2 drones should arrive by the New Year.
To je izjavio na konferenciji za medije pred Dan Oružanih snaga BiH, 1. decembra.
He said this at a press conference ahead of the Day of the Armed Forces of BiH on 1 December.
Rok je pomjeren već nekoliko puta, a ranije je najavljivao mart pa kraj maja 2026.
The deadline has already been moved several times, and earlier he had announced March and then the end of May 2026.
Do Nove godine trebala bi stići i oklopna vozila Kirpi 2 i sistem za zaštitu od dronova.
Kirpi 2 armoured vehicles and an anti-drone system should also arrive by the New Year.
Helez je rekao da je kupljeno 6 novih helikoptera, a 60 pilota se obučava u Turskoj i SAD-u.
Helez said that 6 new helicopters had been bought, and 60 pilots are training in Turkey and the US.
Plate u vojsci i ministarstvu porast će za 13,7 posto.
Salaries in the army and the ministry will rise by 13.7 percent.
Za četiri godine vojska je primila oko 4.000 novih ljudi, od toga oko 750 ove godine.
In four years the army has taken on about 4,000 new people, about 750 of them this year.
O dronovima se govori više od dvije godine, a 2024. je najavljeno da stižu u januaru 2025.
The drones have been talked about for more than two years, and in 2024 it was announced they would arrive in January 2025.
Isporuku je kasnije usporio PDV, porez koji se plaća i na vojnu opremu koja se dobije kao poklon.
The delivery was later slowed by VAT, a tax that is also paid on military equipment received as a gift.
Helez je rekao i da je vojska BiH spremna poslati jedinice u mirovnu misiju u Gazi.
Helez also said that the BiH army is ready to send units to a peacekeeping mission in Gaza.

title: Mnogo policije ispred suda u Banjoj Luci zbog ročišta Oriću
Many police outside the court in Banja Luka over Orić hearing
body: Ispred Okružnog suda u Banjoj Luci danas su raspoređene jake policijske snage.
Strong police forces were deployed outside the District Court in Banja Luka today.
U sudu se održava ročište za Nasera Orića i još četiri osobe.
A hearing for Naser Orić and four other people is being held in the court.
Neki policajci su nosili i duge cijevi, odnosno puške.
Some police officers were also carrying long-barrelled weapons, that is, rifles.
Ročište je trebalo početi ujutro, ali je pomjereno na 12:15, a novinari nisu smjeli ući u sudnicu.
The hearing was supposed to start in the morning, but it was moved to 12:15, and journalists were not allowed into the courtroom.
Tužilaštvo Republike Srpske traži pritvor za Orića, Nikolinu Šljivić, Mesuda i Mustafu Mustafića i Sinišu Derganca.
The Prosecutor's Office of Republika Srpska is seeking custody for Orić, Nikolina Šljivić, Mesud and Mustafa Mustafić and Siniša Derganc.
O tome će odlučiti sudija za prethodni postupak.
A pre-trial judge will decide on that.
Pritvor znači da bi osumnjičeni ostali u zatvoru dok traje istraga.
Custody means that the suspects would stay in prison while the investigation lasts.
Petorica osumnjičenih su uhapšeni jer se sumnja da su pomagali Đorđu Ždrali.
The five suspects were arrested because they are suspected of helping Đorđe Ždrale.
Ždrale je osumnjičen za pokušaj ubistva Koste Pandurevića i za njim je raspisana međunarodna potjernica.
Ždrale is suspected of the attempted murder of Kosta Pandurević, and an international arrest warrant has been issued for him.
Akciju „Emisar“ provela je policija RS-a, uz pomoć SIPA-e.
The police of RS carried out the operation "Emisar" with the help of SIPA.

title: Evropski parlament traži od Srbije da otvori arhive o Vukovaru
European Parliament asks Serbia to open its archives on Vukovar
body: Evropski parlament je danas u Strasbourgu usvojio rezoluciju o Vukovaru.
The European Parliament adopted a resolution on Vukovar in Strasbourg today.
Povod je 35. godišnjica pada i razaranja tog hrvatskog grada.
The occasion is the 35th anniversary of the fall and destruction of that Croatian city.
To je prva rezolucija koja govori samo o stradanju Vukovara.
It is the first resolution that is only about the suffering of Vukovar.
Rezoluciju je predložio hrvatski zastupnik Karlo Ressler, a potpisali su je svi hrvatski zastupnici i petero kolega iz drugih zemalja.
Croatian MEP Karlo Ressler proposed the resolution, and all Croatian MEPs and five colleagues from other countries signed it.
Hrvatska još traži 1.725 nestalih osoba, pa parlament traži od Srbije da otvori svoje arhive.
Croatia is still looking for 1,725 missing people, so the parliament is asking Serbia to open its archives.
U tekstu se spominju i zločini na Ovčari i logori koje je vodila JNA.
The text also mentions the crimes at Ovčara and the camps run by the JNA.
Parlament osuđuje svako negiranje ratnih zločina i veličanje ratnih zločinaca.
The parliament condemns any denial of war crimes and glorification of war criminals.
Glasanje su s balkona pratili stanovnici Vukovara i porodice nestalih.
Residents of Vukovar and families of the missing watched the vote from the balcony.
Ljiljana Alvir, koja vodi udruženje porodica nestalih, rekla je da rezolucija daje novu malu nadu.
Ljiljana Alvir, who leads an association of families of the missing, said that the resolution gives new, small hope.
Studenti u Srbiji su prije glasanja rekli da rezolucija zanemaruje srpske žrtve.
Students in Serbia said before the vote that the resolution ignores Serbian victims.
Predsjednica parlamenta Roberta Metsola poslat će tekst vladama u EU i na Zapadnom Balkanu.
Parliament President Roberta Metsola will send the text to governments in the EU and the Western Balkans.

title: Preminuo sarajevski grafičar i profesor Avdo Žiga
Sarajevo printmaker and professor Avdo Žiga has died
body: U 74. godini preminuo je Avdo Žiga, poznati grafičar i profesor Akademije likovnih umjetnosti u Sarajevu.
Avdo Žiga, a well-known printmaker and professor at the Academy of Fine Arts in Sarajevo, has died at the age of 74.
Grafičar je umjetnik koji pravi otiske slika s ploča od metala, drveta ili kamena.
A printmaker is an artist who makes prints of images from plates of metal, wood or stone.
Dženaza će biti u petak, 27. novembra, u 13:30 na mezarju Vlakovo.
The funeral will be on Friday, 27 November, at 13:30 at Vlakovo cemetery.
Žiga je rođen u Sarajevu 1953. godine, a sarajevsku Akademiju je završio 1978.
Žiga was born in Sarajevo in 1953, and he graduated from the Sarajevo Academy in 1978.
Postdiplomski studij završio je u Beogradu, a 1986. je učio tehniku bakroreza u Parizu.
He completed postgraduate studies in Belgrade, and in 1986 he studied the technique of copper engraving in Paris.
Njegovi radovi bili su na mnogim izložbama u BiH i u inostranstvu.
His works were shown at many exhibitions in BiH and abroad.
U Umjetničkoj galeriji BiH 2017. je pokazano više od 50 njegovih grafika.
More than 50 of his prints were shown at the Art Gallery of BiH in 2017.
Dugo je na Akademiji predavao grafiku i crtanje i bio mentor mnogim studentima.
For a long time he taught printmaking and drawing at the Academy and mentored many students.
Bio je i predsjednik Udruženja likovnih umjetnika BiH.
He was also president of the Association of Fine Artists of BiH.
U tekstu se navodi da je njegov rad ostavio veliki trag na umjetničkoj sceni Sarajeva i BiH.
The article says that his work left a big mark on the art scene of Sarajevo and BiH.

title: SDA bira kandidate, Nezir Pivić mogući novi premijer FBiH
SDA picks candidates, Nezir Pivić possible new FBiH prime minister
body: Stranka demokratske akcije (SDA) danas i sutra bira svoje kandidate za najvažnije funkcije u novoj vlasti.
The Party of Democratic Action (SDA) is choosing its candidates for the most important posts in the new government today and tomorrow.
Danas se sastaje kolegij stranke, a sutra kadrovska komisija i predsjedništvo SDA.
The party's leadership board meets today, and the personnel commission and the SDA presidency meet tomorrow.
Oni trebaju potvrditi kandidate za vlast u Federaciji BiH i na državnom nivou.
They are to confirm the candidates for the government in the Federation of BiH and at state level.
Za premijera FBiH najvjerovatnije će biti predložen Nezir Pivić, sadašnji premijer Zeničko-dobojskog kantona.
Nezir Pivić, the current prime minister of Zenica-Doboj Canton, will most likely be proposed for FBiH prime minister.
Razmatran je i Suad Huskić, bivši načelnik Tešnja, ali Pivić ima prednost.
Suad Huskić, the former mayor of Tešanj, was also considered, but Pivić has the advantage.
SDA će predložiti i kandidate za rukovodstvo parlamenata, a konstituirajuće sjednice zakazane su za 1. decembar.
SDA will also propose candidates for the leadership of the parliaments, and the inaugural sessions are scheduled for 1 December.
Očekuje se da u novoj vladi FBiH budu i HDZ, Stranka za BiH i DF.
HDZ, the Party for BiH and DF are expected to be in the new FBiH government as well.
Razgovori o programu rada još traju, pa nije sigurno ko će na kraju formirati vladu.
Talks on the work programme are still going on, so it is not certain who will form the government in the end.
SDA poručuje da je SDP dobrodošao u vlast na državnom nivou, ali da u FBiH treba promijeniti neke kadrove.
SDA says that SDP is welcome in the state-level government, but that it should change some of its people in the FBiH.
Uloga SDP-a mogla bi zavisiti i od optužnica protiv Vojina Mijatovića i Nermina Nikšića.
SDP's role could also depend on the indictments against Vojin Mijatović and Nermin Nikšić.
Više bi se trebalo znati sljedeće sedmice.
More should be known next week.

title: Kineski leteći automobil uskoro ide u masovnu proizvodnju
Chinese flying car is soon going into mass production
body: Kineski proizvođač automobila Xpeng pokazao je leteće vozilo u svom sjedištu u gradu Guangzhou.
Chinese carmaker Xpeng showed a flying vehicle at its headquarters in the city of Guangzhou.
Vozilo se zove Land Aircraft Carrier, a razvila ga je Xpengova firma Aridge.
The vehicle is called Land Aircraft Carrier, and it was developed by Xpeng's company Aridge.
Letjelica je poletjela iznad zgrada kompanije i sletjela na platformu pred novinarima.
The aircraft took off above the company's buildings and landed on a platform in front of journalists.
Proizvod ima dva dijela: kombi sa 6 točkova i malu letjelicu koja stoji u njegovom prtljažniku.
The product has two parts: a van with 6 wheels and a small aircraft that sits in its boot.
Kombi ne leti, nego samo vozi letjelicu do mjesta gdje je letenje dozvoljeno.
The van does not fly, but only drives the aircraft to a place where flying is allowed.
Tamo letjelica izlazi, polijeće, leti i slijeće na jednu komandu, a zatim se vraća u kombi.
There the aircraft comes out, takes off, flies and lands on a single command, and then returns to the van.
Fabrika u Guangzhouu može napraviti do 10.000 ovakvih vozila godišnje.
The factory in Guangzhou can make up to 10,000 such vehicles a year.
Aridge tvrdi da je to prvi takav leteći automobil koji ide u masovnu proizvodnju.
Aridge claims that it is the first flying car of this kind that is going into mass production.
Kompanija ima više od 7.000 narudžbi iz cijelog svijeta, od toga oko 600 s Bliskog istoka.
The company has more than 7,000 orders from all over the world, about 600 of them from the Middle East.
Kupci bi prva vozila trebali dobiti 2026. godine, ali kineske vlasti još nisu dale sve dozvole.
Customers should receive the first vehicles in 2026, but the Chinese authorities have not yet given all the permits.

title: Struja se vraća u dijelove Sarajeva nakon jutarnjeg kvara
Power returns to parts of Sarajevo after a morning fault
body: Dijelovi Sarajeva u četvrtak ujutro su ostali bez struje zbog kvara na transformatoru u Velešićima.
Parts of Sarajevo were left without electricity on Thursday morning because of a fault on the transformer in Velešići.
Kvar je sada otklonjen, a struja se postepeno vraća u domove.
The fault has now been fixed, and power is gradually returning to homes.
To je za Klix.ba potvrdila Elektroprivreda BiH.
Elektroprivreda BiH confirmed this to Klix.ba.
Problem je nastao na transformatoru od 110 kilovolti.
The problem occurred on a 110-kilovolt transformer.
Transformator je veliki uređaj koji mijenja napon struje prije nego što ona stigne do kuća.
A transformer is a large device that changes the voltage of electricity before it reaches houses.
Za ovaj transformator nije odgovorna Elektroprivreda, nego kompanija Elektroprijenos BiH.
Elektroprivreda is not responsible for this transformer, but the company Elektroprijenos BiH is.
Mnogi stanovnici su jutro počeli bez svjetla i grijanja.
Many residents started the morning without light and heating.
Ovo nije prvi put da ovaj transformator ispadne iz sistema.
This is not the first time this transformer has dropped out of the system.
Zbog toga stanovnici ovog dijela grada često nemaju stabilno napajanje strujom.
Because of that, residents of this part of the city often do not have a stable power supply.
Elektroprijenos BiH jutros nije komentarisao ovaj kvar.
Elektroprijenos BiH did not comment on this fault this morning.

title: Nagla hladnoća povećava rizik od srčanog i moždanog udara
Sudden cold increases the risk of heart attack and stroke
body: Kada temperature naglo padnu, raste rizik od srčanog i moždanog udara.
When temperatures suddenly drop, the risk of heart attack and stroke rises.
Najviše su ugroženi ljudi koji već imaju bolesti srca.
People who already have heart disease are most at risk.
Kardiolozi, ljekari za srce, savjetuju da ljudi unaprijed nauče znakove upozorenja.
Cardiologists, heart doctors, advise people to learn the warning signs in advance.
Na hladnoći tijelo sužava krvne sudove, a zbog toga raste krvni pritisak.
In the cold the body narrows the blood vessels, and because of that blood pressure rises.
Jaka hladnoća može i zgusnuti krv, pa se lakše stvaraju ugrušci.
Strong cold can also thicken the blood, so clots form more easily.
Jedan pregled istraživanja iz 2023. godine pokazao je da talasi hladnoće povećavaju smrtnost od bolesti srca za 32 posto.
A review of research from 2023 showed that cold waves increase deaths from heart disease by 32 percent.
Opasan može biti i težak rad na hladnoći, na primjer čišćenje snijega.
Hard work in the cold can also be dangerous, for example clearing snow.
Znakovi upozorenja su bol u prsima, ruci, leđima ili vilici, kao i kratak dah i hladan znoj.
Warning signs are pain in the chest, arm, back or jaw, as well as shortness of breath and cold sweat.
Ako ljudi primijete takve znakove, trebaju odmah nazvati hitnu pomoć na broj 124.
If people notice such signs, they should immediately call the emergency service at number 124.
Ljekari savjetuju i toplu odjeću te malo alkohola, jer alkohol daje lažan osjećaj topline.
Doctors also advise warm clothes and little alcohol, because alcohol gives a false feeling of warmth.

title: Parada za Dan zahvalnosti u New Yorku odgođena zbog nevremena
Thanksgiving parade in New York postponed because of a storm
body: Kompanija Macy's prvi put je odgodila svoju poznatu paradu za Dan zahvalnosti u New Yorku.
The company Macy's has postponed its famous Thanksgiving parade in New York for the first time.
Parada je trebala biti u četvrtak, a sada će biti u subotu u 8:30.
The parade was supposed to be on Thursday, and now it will be on Saturday at 8:30.
Ovo je 100. parada, a razlog za odgodu je jak vjetar.
This is the 100th parade, and the reason for the postponement is strong wind.
Meteorološka služba upozorila je na jak vjetar i poplave na obali od četvrtka do petka.
The weather service warned of strong wind and coastal flooding from Thursday to Friday.
Gradonačelnik Zohran Mamdani rekao je da bi vjetar mogao lomiti grane i rušiti električne vodove.
Mayor Zohran Mamdani said the wind could break branches and bring down power lines.
Dodao je da je sigurnost na prvom mjestu i da je odluka ispravna.
He added that safety comes first and that the decision is right.
Televizija NBC u četvrtak će prikazati paradu iz 2025. godine.
NBC television will show the parade from 2025 on Thursday.
Parada nije održana od 1942. do 1944. godine, za vrijeme Drugog svjetskog rata.
The parade was not held from 1942 to 1944, during the Second World War.
Baloni zbog vremena nisu letjeli samo jednom, 1971. godine.
The balloons did not fly because of the weather only once, in 1971.
Nakon nesreće 1997. godine grad ima pravila za jak vjetar, jer je tada balon udario u stub i povrijedio jednu ženu.
After an accident in 1997 the city has rules for strong wind, because a balloon then hit a pole and injured a woman.

title: Greška golmana Lammensa koštala United pobjede u Lisabonu
Goalkeeper Lammens's mistake cost United a win in Lisbon
body: Manchester United igrao je 2:2 protiv Sportinga u Lisabonu u 5. kolu Lige prvaka.
Manchester United drew 2-2 with Sporting in Lisbon in the 5th round of the Champions League.
Golman Senne Lammens napravio je veliku grešku u 80. minuti.
Goalkeeper Senne Lammens made a big mistake in the 80th minute.
Zbog toga trener Mauricio Pochettino još čeka prvu pobjedu na klupi Uniteda.
Because of that, coach Mauricio Pochettino is still waiting for his first win on the United bench.
Sporting je poveo u 33. minuti, kada je Luis Suárez postigao gol iz penala.
Sporting took the lead in the 33rd minute, when Luis Suárez scored from a penalty.
Na početku drugog poluvremena Bruno Fernandes zabio je 2 gola, u 48. i 50. minuti.
At the start of the second half Bruno Fernandes scored 2 goals, in the 48th and 50th minute.
Tako je United došao do vodstva od 2:1.
That is how United got a 2-1 lead.
U 80. minuti Lammens nije uhvatio loptu nakon centaršuta, dok ga je Suárez napadao.
In the 80th minute Lammens did not catch the ball after a cross, while Suárez was pressing him.
Suárez je iskoristio grešku i postavio konačni rezultat 2:2.
Suárez took advantage of the mistake and set the final score at 2-2.
Za United i novog trenera to je bio težak kraj večeri.
For United and the new coach it was a difficult end to the evening.

title: U2 na NFL utakmici odao počast Dolly Parton
U2 paid tribute to Dolly Parton at an NFL game
body: Grupa U2 nastupila je u srijedu na poluvremenu NFL utakmice u Kaliforniji.
The band U2 performed on Wednesday at halftime of an NFL game in California.
Igrali su Green Bay Packers i Los Angeles Rams na stadionu SoFi, a utakmicu je prenosio Netflix.
Green Bay Packers and Los Angeles Rams played at SoFi Stadium, and Netflix broadcast the game.
Bila je to prva NFL utakmica uoči Dana zahvalnosti.
It was the first NFL game on the eve of Thanksgiving.
Grupa je odala počast Dolly Parton pjesmom "Torn", duetom Bona i ove pjevačice.
The band paid tribute to Dolly Parton with the song "Torn", a duet of Bono and this singer.
To je posljednji snimak njenog glasa, a ona je umrla 25. augusta u 80. godini.
It is the last recording of her voice, and she died on 25 August at the age of 80.
Bono je pjevao uz njen snimljeni glas, dok se njen lik vidio na ekranima.
Bono sang along with her recorded voice, while her image was seen on the screens.
U2 je ukupno izveo 5 pjesama, a s njima je nastupilo i oko 100 pjevača u horu.
U2 performed 5 songs in total, and about 100 singers in a choir performed with them.
"Torn" je jedina objavljena pjesma s novog albuma "Carnaval De Luz".
"Torn" is the only released song from the new album "Carnaval De Luz".
To je 16. studijski album grupe, a pjesma je na njegovom kraju.
It is the band's 16th studio album, and the song is at its end.
Dolly Parton je 2023. godine i sama nastupila na poluvremenu jedne utakmice za Dan zahvalnosti.
In 2023 Dolly Parton herself performed at halftime of a Thanksgiving game.

title: Danas kiša u većem dijelu BiH, u planinama snijeg
Rain in most of BiH today, snow in the mountains
body: U Bosni i Hercegovini danas će biti uglavnom oblačno, s kišom i pljuskovima.
In Bosnia and Herzegovina it will be mostly cloudy today, with rain and showers.
Najviše kiše očekuje se u Hercegovini, istočnoj Bosni i dijelu zapadnih krajeva.
The most rain is expected in Herzegovina, eastern Bosnia and part of the western areas.
U višim predjelima padat će snijeg, a za Sarajevo vrijedi žuto upozorenje zbog kiše i vjetra.
Snow will fall in higher areas, and a yellow warning for rain and wind is in force for Sarajevo.
Vjetar će biti umjeren do jak, s juga, ali će poslije podne oslabiti.
The wind will be moderate to strong, from the south, but it will weaken in the afternoon.
Najtoplije će biti u Mostaru i Trebinju, do 13 stepeni.
It will be warmest in Mostar and Trebinje, up to 13 degrees.
U Sarajevu se očekuje do 11, a u Tuzli do 6 stepeni.
Up to 11 degrees is expected in Sarajevo, and up to 6 in Tuzla.
Na sjeverozapadu će biti mnogo hladnije, u Banjoj Luci oko 2, a u Bihaću oko 1 stepen.
In the northwest it will be much colder, about 2 degrees in Banja Luka and about 1 degree in Bihać.
Sutra će također biti oblačno i kišovito.
Tomorrow will also be cloudy and rainy.
U Bihaću će ujutro padati susnježica, a tokom dana snijeg, na oko 0 stepeni.
In Bihać there will be sleet in the morning and snow during the day, at about 0 degrees.
Na jugu će i dalje biti toplije, do 13 stepeni.
In the south it will still be warmer, up to 13 degrees.
Prognozu je objavio Federalni hidrometeorološki zavod.
The forecast was published by the Federal Hydrometeorological Institute.

title: Mladi Deket zahvalio Kolašincu prije utakmice s Atalantom
Young Deket thanked Kolašinac before the match against Atalanta
body: Matej Deket, napadač Borca iz Banje Luke, govorio je novinarima prije utakmice protiv Atalante.
Matej Deket, a striker for Borac from Banja Luka, spoke to journalists before the match against Atalanta.
Borac i Atalanta igraju večeras u 21:00 na Gradskom stadionu u Banjoj Luci.
Borac and Atalanta play tonight at 21:00 at the City Stadium in Banja Luka.
To je utakmica 4. kola Konferencijske lige.
It is a match of the 4th round of the Conference League.
Deket ima samo 17 godina, a ovog mjeseca je prvi put pozvan u A reprezentaciju BiH.
Deket is only 17 years old, and this month he was called up to the BiH senior national team for the first time.
Pozvao ga je selektor Sergej Barbarez.
He was called up by head coach Sergej Barbarez.
Na okupljanju je upoznao kapitena Seada Kolašinca i zahvalio mu je što ga je lijepo primio.
At the training camp he met captain Sead Kolašinac and thanked him for welcoming him so nicely.
Stadion je rasprodat, a navijači Atalante kupili su 494 karte.
The stadium is sold out, and Atalanta fans bought 494 tickets.
Deket je rekao da Borac poštuje Atalantu, ali da će se boriti za dobar rezultat.
Deket said that Borac respects Atalanta, but that it will fight for a good result.
Dodao je da tim nije pod pritiskom i da želi dati sve na terenu.
He added that the team is not under pressure and wants to give everything on the pitch.
Italijanski novinari pitali su ga ko mu je omiljeni igrač Atalante, a on je izabrao Charlesa De Ketelaerea.
Italian journalists asked him who his favourite Atalanta player is, and he chose Charles De Ketelaere.

title: Iran kaže da ga američka blokada luka ne brine
Iran says the American blockade of its ports does not worry it
body: Prvi potpredsjednik Irana Mohammad Reza Aref rekao je u srijedu da Teheran ne brine američka pomorska blokada.
Iran's First Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref said on Wednesday that the American naval blockade does not worry Tehran.
Prema njegovim riječima, sve više robe stiže u zemlju preko kopnenih granica.
According to him, more and more goods are arriving in the country across land borders.
Vlada u isto vrijeme pokušava zaustaviti rast cijena.
At the same time, the government is trying to stop prices from rising.
Iran ima jednu od najvećih inflacija u posljednjih nekoliko decenija, a uzrok je rat koji traje gotovo 9 mjeseci.
Iran has one of the highest inflation rates in the last few decades, and the cause is a war that has lasted almost 9 months.
Cijene su u oktobru bile 88,7 posto veće nego godinu ranije.
Prices in October were 88.7 percent higher than a year earlier.
Hrana i pića su poskupjeli čak 112,6 posto.
Food and drinks went up in price by as much as 112.6 percent.
SAD su u julu ponovo blokirale iranske luke, a ovog mjeseca su najavile i kontrolu kopnenih granica i Kaspijskog jezera.
The US blocked Iranian ports again in July, and this month they also announced control of the land borders and the Caspian Sea.
Aref je rekao da zemlja ima dovoljno zaliha, ali nije naveo brojke.
Aref said the country has enough reserves, but he did not give numbers.
Vlada želi da cijene osnovnih proizvoda ne rastu najmanje 3 mjeseca.
The government wants prices of basic products not to rise for at least 3 months.
Predsjednik Masoud Pezeshkian rekao je da će više novca ići siromašnijim zajednicama.
President Masoud Pezeshkian said that more money will go to poorer communities.

title: SpaceX smije poslati milion satelita, naučnici sumnjaju
SpaceX may send a million satellites, scientists have doubts
body: Američka komisija za komunikacije FCC odobrila je u srijedu veliki plan kompanije SpaceX.
The American communications commission FCC approved a big plan of the company SpaceX on Wednesday.
Kompanija smije poslati u svemir milion satelita koji bi radili kao centri za podatke.
The company may send into space a million satellites that would work as data centres.
Projekat se zove "Starmind", a sateliti bi obrađivali velike količine podataka za ljude na Zemlji.
The project is called "Starmind", and the satellites would process large amounts of data for people on Earth.
Šef FCC-a Brendan Carr rekao je da je to historijski korak.
FCC chief Brendan Carr said it is a historic step.
SpaceX mora prvu stanicu postaviti do 2033. godine, a ostale postepeno do 2040.
SpaceX must set up the first station by 2033, and the others gradually by 2040.
Elon Musk je odluku pozdravio na društvenim mrežama.
Elon Musk welcomed the decision on social media.
Mnogi naučnici ipak sumnjaju da je plan moguć.
Many scientists, however, doubt that the plan is possible.
Astrofizičar Adam Becker rekao je da je to fantazija, jer je u svemiru teško osloboditi se toplote.
Astrophysicist Adam Becker said it is a fantasy, because in space it is hard to get rid of heat.
Stručnjaci upozoravaju i na zagađenje i na opasnost od sudara u orbiti.
Experts also warn of pollution and the danger of collisions in orbit.
Američko astronomsko društvo kaže da bi toliko satelita smetalo posmatranju noćnog neba.
The American Astronomical Society says that so many satellites would interfere with observing the night sky.

title: Kim Jong-un traži više nuklearnog oružja
Kim Jong-un calls for more nuclear weapons
body: Sjevernokorejski lider Kim Jong-un posjetio je fabrike koje proizvode nuklearni materijal.
North Korean leader Kim Jong-un visited factories that produce nuclear material.
Tom prilikom je pozvao na proizvodnju novog nuklearnog oružja.
On that occasion he called for the production of new nuclear weapons.
Državna agencija KCNA objavila je vijest u četvrtak.
The state agency KCNA published the news on Thursday.
Kim je obišao 2 fabrike, jednu novu i jednu koja se širi.
Kim toured 2 factories, one new and one that is being expanded.
Na fotografijama se vide uređaji za obogaćivanje uranija i dijelovi koji izgledaju kao bojeve glave.
The photos show devices for enriching uranium and parts that look like warheads.
U srijedu je posjetio i bazu za podmornice na nuklearni pogon i jedan istraživački institut.
On Wednesday he also visited a base for nuclear-powered submarines and a research institute.
Lokacije fabrika nisu objavljene.
The locations of the factories were not published.
Kim je rekao da je nuklearni status Sjeverne Koreje stvarnost koja se ne može promijeniti.
Kim said that North Korea's nuclear status is a reality that cannot be changed.
Sve se desilo nekoliko dana nakon što Pjongjang nije odgovorio na Trumpovu ponudu za susret.
It all happened a few days after Pyongyang did not respond to Trump's offer of a meeting.
Trump je ipak rekao da ga Kim nije ignorisao i da će njihov susret doći.
Trump still said that Kim had not ignored him and that their meeting will come.
Južna Koreja kaže da ozbiljno shvata Kimove riječi.
South Korea says it takes Kim's words seriously.

title: Srbija bira predsjednika najkasnije 27. decembra
Serbia elects a president by 27 December at the latest
body: Predsjednik Skupštine Srbije Aleksandar Čupić sutra će raspisati izbore za predsjednika Srbije.
The Speaker of the Serbian Assembly Aleksandar Čupić will call elections for the president of Serbia tomorrow.
Odluku će potpisati u 12 sati u zgradi Skupštine u Beogradu.
He will sign the decision at 12 o'clock in the Assembly building in Belgrade.
Mandat Aleksandra Vučića završio je 27. septembra.
Aleksandar Vučić's term ended on 27 September.
Zato izbori moraju biti održani najkasnije do 27. decembra.
That is why the election must be held by 27 December at the latest.
Glasanje mora biti od 30 do 60 dana nakon što se izbori raspišu.
The vote must be 30 to 60 days after the election is called.
Svaki kandidat treba najmanje 10.000 potpisa birača.
Every candidate needs at least 10,000 voter signatures.
Kandidate mogu predložiti stranke, koalicije i grupe građana.
Candidates can be nominated by parties, coalitions and groups of citizens.
Predsjednika biraju građani, a pobjednik u prvom krugu mora dobiti više od pola glasova.
The president is chosen by the citizens, and a winner in the first round must get more than half of the votes.
Ako niko ne uspije, dva najbolja kandidata idu u drugi krug.
If nobody succeeds, the two best candidates go to a second round.
Pobjednik će nakon toga položiti zakletvu pred Skupštinom.
After that the winner will take the oath before the Assembly.

title: Serija "The Body" i film "Guarding Stars" na vrhu Netflixa
The series "The Body" and the film "Guarding Stars" at the top of Netflix
body: Netflix je objavio listu najgledanijih serija i filmova za sedmicu od 16. novembra.
Netflix published the list of the most-watched series and films for the week from 16 November.
Među serijama na engleskom jeziku prva je nova serija "The Body" s 9,5 miliona pregleda.
Among English-language series, the new series "The Body" is first with 9.5 million views.
Serija govori o plesnoj grupi čiji neuspjeli ritual uznemiri cijelu zajednicu.
The series is about a dance group whose failed ritual disturbs the whole community.
Na drugom mjestu je druga sezona serije "Black Doves" s Keirom Knightley, sa 3,7 miliona pregleda.
In second place is the second season of the series "Black Doves" with Keira Knightley, with 3.7 million views.
Najgledaniji film je božićna romantična komedija "Guarding Stars" s 27,6 miliona pregleda.
The most-watched film is the Christmas romantic comedy "Guarding Stars" with 27.6 million views.
To je skoro dvaput više nego što ima film na drugom mjestu.
That is almost twice as much as the film in second place has.
Drugi je triler "Heartland" s Jessicom Chastain, a treći je animirani film "Steps".
Second is the thriller "Heartland" with Jessica Chastain, and third is the animated film "Steps".
Među filmovima na drugim jezicima drugu sedmicu vodi indonezijski akcijski film "Never Surrender".
Among films in other languages, the Indonesian action film "Never Surrender" leads for the second week.
Najgledanija serija na drugim jezicima je poljska drama "The Law of Beasts".
The most-watched series in other languages is the Polish drama "The Law of Beasts".
Ta serija ima četiri epizode i zasniva se na stvarnim događajima.
That series has four episodes and is based on real events.

title: Džeko nezadovoljan što na Schalkeu sjedi na klupi
Džeko unhappy that he sits on the bench at Schalke
body: Edin Džeko je ljut jer u Schalkeu sve češće počinje utakmice kao rezerva.
Edin Džeko is angry because at Schalke he more and more often starts games as a substitute.
U subotu je ušao u igru tek u 86. minuti utakmice protiv Stuttgarta, koja je završila 0:0.
On Saturday he came on only in the 86th minute of the game against Stuttgart, which ended 0:0.
Nakon utakmice otišao je s terena bez pozdrava navijačima.
After the game he left the pitch without greeting the fans.
Prema listu WAZ, Džeko je prošao pored novinara i nije dao izjavu.
According to the newspaper WAZ, Džeko walked past the journalists and did not give a statement.
Na početku sezone dao je dva gola u Kupu Njemačke.
At the start of the season he scored two goals in the German Cup.
Od tada je u 11 utakmica imao samo jednu asistenciju i tri puta je bio u prvoj postavi.
Since then he has had only one assist in 11 games and was in the starting line-up three times.
Trener Miron Muslić rekao je da bira igrače prema taktici, a ne prema imenu.
Coach Miron Muslić said that he chooses players by tactics, not by name.
Golman Loris Karius stao je u odbranu Džeke.
Goalkeeper Loris Karius stood up for Džeko.
Rekao je da su igrači emotivni i da je dobro kada žele igrati.
He said that players are emotional and that it is good when they want to play.
Schalke u subotu igra protiv Paderborna, a ako Džeko da gol, bit će najstariji strijelac u historiji Bundeslige.
Schalke play Paderborn on Saturday, and if Džeko scores, he will be the oldest goalscorer in Bundesliga history.

title: Džanan Musa igrao sa zaštitnim naočalama protiv Partizana
Džanan Musa played with protective goggles against Partizan
body: Bosanskohercegovački košarkaš Džanan Musa vratio se na teren u utakmici svog Dubaija protiv Partizana.
Bosnian-Herzegovinian basketball player Džanan Musa returned to the court in his team Dubai's game against Partizan.
Igrao je sa zaštitnim naočalama jer je prošle sedmice povrijedio oko.
He played with protective goggles because he injured his eye last week.
Povreda se dogodila u Euroligi, na utakmici protiv Maccabija na Kipru.
The injury happened in the EuroLeague, in a game against Maccabi in Cyprus.
Igrač Maccabija Armando Bacot udario ga je u lice dok je išao prema košu.
Maccabi player Armando Bacot hit him in the face while he was going towards the basket.
Musa je morao izaći i do kraja utakmice nije se vratio.
Musa had to leave and did not return until the end of the game.
Sudije nisu dosudile težak prekršaj, ali je Dubai ipak pobijedio 80:74.
The referees did not call a serious foul, but Dubai still won 80:74.
Nakon 13 kola Eurolige Dubai ima devet pobjeda i četiri poraza.
After 13 rounds of the EuroLeague, Dubai has nine wins and four losses.
Musa nije putovao s reprezentacijom BiH na Island.
Musa did not travel with the BiH national team to Iceland.
Selektor Dario Gjergja rekao je da će Musa igrati protiv Litvanije u nedjelju u Zetri.
Head coach Dario Gjergja said that Musa will play against Lithuania on Sunday in Zetra.
Ta utakmica je kvalifikacija za Svjetsko prvenstvo, a čini se da je oko dovoljno zacijelilo.
That game is a qualifier for the World Cup, and it seems the eye has healed enough.

title: Stare novine pisale o hrabrim vojnicima iz BiH
Old newspapers wrote about brave soldiers from BiH
body: Klix.ba je objavio tekst o tome kako su novine u Prvom svjetskom ratu pisale o vojnicima iz Bosne i Hercegovine.
Klix.ba published a text about how newspapers in the First World War wrote about soldiers from Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Tekst se zasniva na dvjema sarajevskim novinama na njemačkom jeziku iz tog vremena.
The text is based on two Sarajevo newspapers in German from that time.
Stare stranice čuva Nacionalna i univerzitetska biblioteka BiH.
The old pages are kept by the National and University Library of BiH.
Od 1914. do 1918. godine oficiri i novinari često su hvalili hrabrost tih vojnika.
From 1914 to 1918, officers and journalists often praised the courage of those soldiers.
Novine su ih zvale Bošnjacima, bez obzira na to koje su vjere bili.
The newspapers called them Bosniaks, regardless of their religion.
Jedan oficir je 1916. godine pisao ocu da su vojnici iz Bosne izdržali 16 sati artiljerijske vatre.
In 1916 one officer wrote to his father that the soldiers from Bosnia had endured 16 hours of artillery fire.
Kaplar Huso Zmiro je u decembru 1917. godine u Italiji zarobio jednog majora i njegove ljude.
In December 1917, Corporal Huso Zmiro captured a major and his men in Italy.
Do decembra 1916. jedan puk iz Tuzle dobio je više od 2.000 odlikovanja za vojnike.
By December 1916, one regiment from Tuzla had received more than 2,000 decorations for soldiers.
Vojnici su na front nosili i gusle, tradicionalni instrument s jednom žicom.
The soldiers also carried the gusle, a traditional instrument with one string, to the front.
Uz gusle su pjevali o mjestima gdje su se borili i o svojim komandantima.
With the gusle they sang about the places where they fought and about their commanders.
Autor teksta je naveo da je vojna cenzura tada često skrivala imena mjesta i ljudi.
The author of the text noted that military censorship at that time often hid the names of places and people.

title: Izraelski ministar uvrijedio Palestince u Knessetu
Israeli minister insulted Palestinians in the Knesset
body: Izraelski ministar Amichai Eliyahu uvrijedio je Palestince i muslimane u govoru u Knessetu, izraelskom parlamentu.
Israeli minister Amichai Eliyahu insulted Palestinians and Muslims in a speech in the Knesset, the Israeli parliament.
Tokom rasprave o kriminalu nazvao ih je neukim jahačima deva i barbarima.
During a debate on crime he called them ignorant camel riders and barbarians.
Rekao je i da palestinskim zastupnicima treba obrazovanje.
He also said that Palestinian members of parliament need education.
Međutim, prema portalu Ynet, od 11 zastupnika s doktoratom čak 9 su Palestinci.
However, according to the Ynet portal, of the 11 members with a doctorate as many as 9 are Palestinians.
Eliyahu je poznat po ranijim izjavama koje su izazvale skandal.
Eliyahu is known for earlier statements that caused a scandal.
Kriminal u palestinskoj zajednici u Izraelu je posljednjih godina mnogo porastao.
Crime in the Palestinian community in Israel has risen a lot in recent years.
Prema listu Haaretz, od početka 2026. godine ubijeno je 204 Palestinca.
According to the newspaper Haaretz, 204 Palestinians have been killed since the start of 2026.
Palestinske stranke su na izborima prošlog mjeseca osvojile 19 mjesta, više nego ikada.
Palestinian parties won 19 seats in last month's election, more than ever.
Lider Zajedničke liste Yousef Jabareen rekao je da su napadi na Palestince sve češći.
Joint List leader Yousef Jabareen said that attacks on Palestinians are becoming more frequent.
Za to je optužio premijera Benjamina Netanyahua.
He blamed Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for this.

title: Nikolina Šljivić negira da je pomagala Đorđu Ždrali
Nikolina Šljivić denies that she helped Đorđe Ždrale
body: Bivša zastupnica u Narodnoj skupštini RS-a Nikolina Šljivić iznijela je odbranu u Tužilaštvu u Banjoj Luci.
Former member of the RS National Assembly Nikolina Šljivić presented her defence at the prosecutor's office in Banja Luka.
Ona je negirala da je dio kriminalne grupe i da je pomagala Đorđu Ždrali.
She denied that she is part of a criminal group and that she helped Đorđe Ždrale.
To je rekao njen advokat Miljkan Pucar.
This was said by her lawyer Miljkan Pucar.
Šljivić je uhapšena u utorak u akciji koju su vodili MUP RS-a i SIPA.
Šljivić was arrested on Tuesday in an operation led by the RS Interior Ministry and SIPA.
U istoj akciji uhapšeni su i Naser Orić, Mesud i Mustafa Mustafić te advokat Siniša Derganc.
In the same operation Naser Orić, Mesud and Mustafa Mustafić and lawyer Siniša Derganc were also arrested.
Sumnja se da su pomagali Ždrali da se sakrije, a on se tereti za pokušaj ubistva.
They are suspected of helping Ždrale hide, and he is charged with attempted murder.
Tužilaštvo sumnja da je Orić jednom svjedoku dao 100.000 KM da promijeni izjavu.
The prosecutors suspect that Orić gave a witness 100,000 KM to change his statement.
Policija je u pretresima pronašla osam pištolja, 30.000 KM i 10.000 eura.
In the searches the police found eight pistols, 30,000 KM and 10,000 euros.
Prije ispitivanja Šljivić se osjećala loše, pa je odvezena u bolnicu.
Before the questioning Šljivić felt unwell, so she was taken to hospital.
Odluka o pritvoru bit će poznata kada budu ispitani svi uhapšeni.
The decision on detention will be known when all the arrested people have been questioned.
Policija još traži Ždralu.
The police are still looking for Ždrale.

title: Sarajevo domaćin Evropskog prvenstva u plesu 2027. godine
Sarajevo to host the European dance championship in 2027
body: Sarajevo će u junu 2027. godine biti domaćin Evropskog prvenstva u uličnom plesu.
In June 2027 Sarajevo will host the European Street Dance Championship.
Takmičenje organizuje Međunarodna plesna organizacija, poznata kao IDO.
The competition is organised by the International Dance Organization, known as IDO.
Bosna i Hercegovina prvi put dobija takmičenje ove veličine.
Bosnia and Herzegovina is getting a competition of this size for the first time.
U Sarajevo bi trebalo doći više od 4.000 plesača iz preko 30 evropskih zemalja.
More than 4,000 dancers from over 30 European countries should come to Sarajevo.
Uz njih će doći treneri, međunarodne sudije i ljubitelji plesa.
Along with them, coaches, international judges and dance lovers will come.
Prvenstvo pripremaju Savez modernih plesova u BiH i plesni centar Just Dance.
The championship is being prepared by the Association of Modern Dances in BiH and the dance centre Just Dance.
Organizatori kažu da pripreme traju već mjesecima.
The organisers say that the preparations have been going on for months.
Oni smatraju da je ovo priznanje za dugogodišnji rad plesača u BiH.
They believe this is recognition for many years of work by dancers in BiH.
Prvenstvo bi trebalo pomoći mladima i razvoju sportskog turizma.
The championship should help young people and the development of sports tourism.
Organizatori podsjećaju i na Zimske olimpijske igre, kada je Sarajevo već pokazalo da može organizovati velike događaje.
The organisers also recall the Winter Olympic Games, when Sarajevo already showed that it can organise big events.

title: Jablanica upozorava stanovnike na moguće poplave
Jablanica warns residents of possible floods
body: Općina Jablanica upozorila je stanovnike da u naredna dva dana može doći do poplava.
The Municipality of Jablanica warned residents that floods may occur in the next two days.
Upozorenje se odnosi na područje oko rijeke Neretve, posebno na njen srednji i donji tok.
The warning refers to the area around the Neretva river, especially its middle and lower course.
Općina se oslanja na obavijest Federalnog hidrometeorološkog zavoda.
The municipality relies on a notice from the Federal Hydrometeorological Institute.
Kiša se očekuje od 26. novembra, a najveći vodeni val 26. i 27. novembra.
Rain is expected from 26 November, and the biggest water wave on 26 and 27 November.
Za srijedu je izdato narandžasto upozorenje za jaku kišu u Hercegovini te istočnoj i jugoistočnoj Bosni.
An orange warning for heavy rain has been issued for Wednesday in Herzegovina and eastern and southeastern Bosnia.
Moglo bi pasti od 30 do 60 litara kiše po metru kvadratnom, a negdje i do 80 litara.
From 30 to 60 litres of rain per square metre could fall, and in some places up to 80 litres.
Mali potoci bi se mogli izliti i stvoriti bujice, odnosno brze i opasne tokove vode.
Small streams could overflow and create torrents, that is, fast and dangerous flows of water.
Agencija za vodno područje Jadranskog mora najavila je vanrednu situaciju na rijekama od 26. do 28. novembra.
The Agency for the Adriatic Sea Water Area announced an extraordinary situation on rivers from 26 to 28 November.
Nivo vode u rijekama bi mogao brzo rasti, a moguće su i poplave u gradovima.
The water level in rivers could rise quickly, and floods in towns are also possible.
Službe civilne zaštite trebaju upozoriti ljude koji žive uz rijeke da se drže dalje od obala.
Civil protection services should warn people who live along rivers to stay away from the banks.

title: Uhapšen muškarac zbog oštećenih nišana u Velikom parku
Man arrested over damaged headstones in Veliki park
body: Policija u Sarajevu uhapsila je muškarca za kojeg se sumnja da je oštetio nišane u Velikom parku.
Police in Sarajevo arrested a man who is suspected of damaging headstones in Veliki park.
Tamo su ukopani policajci koji su ubijeni u akciji Trebević 2.
Police officers who were killed in the Trebević 2 operation are buried there.
Riječ je o Sarajliji s inicijalima E. P., koji je rođen 1987. godine.
He is a man from Sarajevo with the initials E. P., who was born in 1987.
Uhapšen je u utorak u 18:10, saopćio je MUP Kantona Sarajevo.
He was arrested on Tuesday at 18:10, the Sarajevo Canton Interior Ministry announced.
Nišani su oštećeni nekoliko dana prije hapšenja.
The headstones were damaged a few days before the arrest.
Na njima su nacrtani vulgarni i uvredljivi simboli, a napisano je i ime Mušana Topalovića Cace.
Vulgar and offensive symbols were drawn on them, and the name of Mušan Topalović Caco was also written.
Muškarac se sumnjiči za oštećenje tuđe stvari i za narušavanje mira umrlih.
The man is suspected of damaging someone else's property and of disturbing the peace of the dead.
O slučaju je obaviješten dežurni tužilac, a osumnjičeni je zadržan u policiji.
The prosecutor on duty was informed about the case, and the suspect was held by the police.
Akcija Trebević 2 održana je 26. oktobra 1993. godine, za vrijeme rata.
The Trebević 2 operation took place on 26 October 1993, during the war.
Naredilo ju je ratno Predsjedništvo, a cilj je bio zaustaviti kriminalce unutar Armije RBiH.
It was ordered by the wartime Presidency, and the goal was to stop criminals within the Army of RBiH.
Bila je usmjerena protiv jedinica Ramiza Delalića, Ismeta Bajramovića i Mušana Topalovića.
It was aimed at the units of Ramiz Delalić, Ismet Bajramović and Mušan Topalović.
U akciji je poginulo nekoliko policajaca.
Several police officers died in the operation.

title: Lana Pudar uz pjesmu „Zemljo moja“ čestitala Dan državnosti
Lana Pudar marked Statehood Day with the song 'Zemljo moja'
body: Najbolja bosanskohercegovačka plivačica Lana Pudar čestitala je danas Dan državnosti BiH.
The best Bosnian-Herzegovinian female swimmer Lana Pudar congratulated on BiH Statehood Day today.
Na Instagramu je objavila priču u kojoj ponosno drži zastavu Bosne i Hercegovine.
On Instagram she posted a story in which she proudly holds the flag of Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Uz sliku se čuje pjesma „Zemljo moja“, jedna od najpoznatijih bosanskih pjesama.
With the picture you can hear the song 'Zemljo moja', one of the best-known Bosnian songs.
Pjesmu je napisao i komponovao Kemal Monteno.
The song was written and composed by Kemal Monteno.
Prvi put je izvedena 1975. godine u Sarajevu, na festivalu Vaš šlager sezone.
It was first performed in 1975 in Sarajevo, at the festival Vaš šlager sezone.
Tada su je pjevali grupa Ambasadori i pjevačica Ismeta Dervoz.
At that time it was sung by the group Ambasadori and the singer Ismeta Dervoz.
Od tada se često pjeva na koncertima i važnim događajima.
Since then it has often been sung at concerts and important events.
Lana Pudar je i ranije nosila zastavu BiH na velikim takmičenjima.
Lana Pudar has also carried the BiH flag at major competitions before.
Njen najveći uspjeh bio je 2022. godine u Rimu.
Her biggest success was in 2022 in Rome.
Tada je postala evropska prvakinja na 200 metara delfin.
At that time she became European champion in the 200 metres butterfly.

title: Dan državnosti: kako mala država može opstati danas
Statehood Day: how a small state can survive today
body: Bosna i Hercegovina danas obilježava Dan državnosti, a autor Belmin Herić tim povodom piše o položaju malih država u svijetu.
Bosnia and Herzegovina is marking Statehood Day today, and on this occasion the author Belmin Herić writes about the position of small states in the world.
On podsjeća da je u noći s 25. na 26. novembar 1943. godine u Mrkonjić Gradu održana prva sjednica ZAVNOBiH-a.
He reminds readers that on the night of 25 to 26 November 1943 the first session of ZAVNOBiH was held in Mrkonjić Grad.
Tada su 247 vijećnika obnovila BiH kao ravnopravnu zajednicu njenih naroda i građana.
At that time 247 councillors restored BiH as an equal community of its peoples and citizens.
Samo dva dana kasnije sastali su se Churchill, Roosevelt i Staljin u Teheranu.
Only two days later Churchill, Roosevelt and Stalin met in Tehran.
Herić piše da je i 2026. godina vrijeme kada velike sile ponovo crtaju karte svijeta.
Herić writes that 2026 is also a time when great powers are again drawing the maps of the world.
Evropska komisija je 4. novembra dala jasniji put Crnoj Gori, Albaniji, Moldaviji i Ukrajini.
On 4 November the European Commission gave a clearer path to Montenegro, Albania, Moldova and Ukraine.
Za BiH autor kaže da je ovo bila izgubljena godina.
For BiH the author says that this was a lost year.
Iz Plana rasta za Zapadni Balkan BiH može dobiti skoro 977 miliona eura, ali još nije povukla ništa.
From the Growth Plan for the Western Balkans BiH can receive almost 977 million euros, but it has not yet drawn anything.
Razlog je to što institucije nisu završile potrebne reforme.
The reason is that the institutions have not finished the necessary reforms.
Autor navodi da vlasti u Republici Srpskoj osporavaju 25. novembar.
The author states that the authorities in Republika Srpska dispute 25 November.
On smatra da mala država može opstati samo ako ima zajedničku vanjsku politiku i institucije koje rade.
He believes that a small state can survive only if it has a common foreign policy and institutions that work.
Također traži ozbiljnu borbu protiv korupcije i kaže da interes države mora biti iznad interesa stranaka.
He also calls for a serious fight against corruption and says that the interest of the state must be above the interest of parties.

title: Mirza Ćatović uspješno operisan, pauza oko četiri mjeseca
Mirza Ćatović successfully operated on, out for about four months
body: Mladi nogometaš Mirza Ćatović uspješno je operisan nakon što je slomio lijevu nogu.
The young footballer Mirza Ćatović was successfully operated on after he broke his left leg.
Operacija je urađena u utorak, a to je potvrdila Barcelona.
The operation was done on Tuesday, and Barcelona confirmed it.
Ćatović ima 19 godina i igra u veznom redu.
Ćatović is 19 years old and plays in midfield.
Klub je saopćio da je slomljena lijeva lisna kost, a povrijeđeni su i ligamenti koji povezuju kosti potkoljenice.
The club announced that the left fibula was broken, and the ligaments that connect the bones of the lower leg were also injured.
Oporavak bi trebao trajati oko 4 mjeseca, što je kraće nego što se očekivalo.
The recovery should last about 4 months, which is shorter than was expected.
Tako bi mogao ponovo igrati krajem marta iduće godine.
That way he could play again at the end of March next year.
Povrijedio se u prvim minutama derbija protiv mladih igrača Espanyola, kada se sudario s golmanom.
He got injured in the first minutes of the derby against Espanyol's young players, when he collided with the goalkeeper.
Ćatović je ovog ljeta došao u drugi tim Barcelone na posudbu iz Stuttgarta.
This summer Ćatović came to Barcelona's second team on loan from Stuttgart.
Ranije je igrao za mlade reprezentacije Njemačke.
Earlier he played for Germany's youth national teams.
Nedavno je predao zahtjev za državljanstvo BiH, pa bi jednog dana mogao igrati za Zmajeve.
He recently submitted an application for BiH citizenship, so one day he could play for the Dragons.

title: Kompanije Alice Huang pomogle finansirati AI centre u Kini
Alice Huang's companies helped finance AI centres in China
body: Kompanije povezane s Alice Huang pomogle su finansirati velike centre za umjetnu inteligenciju u Kini.
Companies connected with Alice Huang helped finance large artificial intelligence centres in China.
Zbog njene veze sa šefom Nvidije Jensenom Huangom on je u novembru kratko napustio kompaniju.
Because of her relationship with Nvidia's boss Jensen Huang, he briefly left the company in November.
Agencija Reuters pregledala je dokumente iz registra kineske centralne banke.
The Reuters agency reviewed documents from a registry of the Chinese central bank.
U tom registru vidi se oprema koja je data kao garancija za kredite.
That registry shows equipment that was given as a guarantee for loans.
Prema dokumentima, riječ je o najviše 764 AI servera i modula vrijednih 270 miliona dolara.
According to the documents, it is up to 764 AI servers and modules worth 270 million dollars.
Tu je i mrežna oprema vrijedna 31 milion dolara, a veliki dio opreme nalazi se u jednom centru u Šangaju.
There is also network equipment worth 31 million dollars, and a large part of the equipment is located in one centre in Shanghai.
Važna je i firma Century Litong, koju Nvidia naziva partnerom za usluge u oblaku.
The firm Century Litong, which Nvidia calls a partner for cloud services, is also important.
Ona je od maja do decembra 2024. potpisala 5 ugovora o najmu za 512 servera vrijednih oko 200 miliona dolara.
From May to December 2024 it signed 5 leasing contracts for 512 servers worth about 200 million dollars.
Američke vlasti istražuju da li je firma Megaspeed iz Singapura pomogla kineskim kupcima da dođu do zabranjene tehnologije.
US authorities are investigating whether the firm Megaspeed from Singapore helped Chinese buyers get banned technology.
U ponedjeljak je Megaspeed stavljen na crnu listu, ali firma odbacuje optužbe.
On Monday Megaspeed was put on the blacklist, but the firm rejects the accusations.
Dokumenti ne pokazuju da su u serverima bili čipovi čiji je izvoz u Kinu zabranjen.
The documents do not show that the servers contained chips whose export to China is banned.

title: Filipović se prvi put sastala s ambasadorom EU Sorecom
Filipović met EU ambassador Soreca for the first time
body: Članica Predsjedništva BiH Darijana Filipović održala je prvi službeni sastanak sa šefom Delegacije EU Luigijem Sorecom.
Member of the BiH Presidency Darijana Filipović held her first official meeting with the head of the EU Delegation Luigi Soreca.
Filipović je dužnost preuzela 16. novembra, a o sastanku je pisala na Facebooku.
Filipović took office on 16 November, and she wrote about the meeting on Facebook.
Razgovarali su o sljedećim koracima BiH na putu prema Evropskoj uniji.
They talked about the next steps of BiH on the road to the European Union.
Cilj je da BiH održi prvu međuvladinu konferenciju i tako zaista počne pregovore.
The goal is for BiH to hold the first intergovernmental conference and thus really start negotiations.
Filipović je rekla da zemlji treba dodatni podsticaj i dogovor da uradi ono što već zna da mora.
Filipović said that the country needs an extra push and an agreement to do what it already knows it must do.
Prema njenim riječima, početak pregovora ne znači da BiH unaprijed mora prihvatiti sve zahtjeve.
According to her, the start of negotiations does not mean that BiH must accept all demands in advance.
Ipak, upozorila je da se unutrašnje blokade i problemi ne smiju predstavljati kao pregovaračke pozicije.
However, she warned that internal blockades and problems must not be presented as negotiating positions.
Rekla je da odgovornost za put prema EU imaju lideri u zemlji.
She said that the leaders in the country are responsible for the road to the EU.
Dodala je da građane zanimaju rezultati, a ne izjave, i da Evropa treba biti standard, a ne parola.
She added that citizens care about results, not statements, and that Europe should be a standard, not a slogan.
Drugi član Predsjedništva Denis Bećirović sastao se sa Sorecom 23. novembra.
Another member of the Presidency, Denis Bećirović, met Soreca on 23 November.

title: Narandžasto upozorenje: u četvrtak obilna kiša na istoku i jugu
Orange warning: heavy rain in the east and south on Thursday
body: Federalni hidrometeorološki zavod izdao je narandžasto upozorenje zbog obilnih padavina u četvrtak, 26. novembra.
The Federal Hydrometeorological Institute issued an orange warning because of heavy precipitation on Thursday, 26 November.
Upozorenje vrijedi za Hercegovinu te za istočnu i jugoistočnu Bosnu.
The warning applies to Herzegovina and to eastern and southeastern Bosnia.
U tim dijelovima zemlje očekuje se mnogo kiše.
A lot of rain is expected in those parts of the country.
Prognoza kaže da bi moglo pasti od 30 do 60 litara kiše po metru kvadratnom.
The forecast says that from 30 to 60 litres of rain per square metre could fall.
Na nekim mjestima moglo bi pasti i do 80 litara.
In some places up to 80 litres could fall.
Zavod upozorava da su moguće poplave zgrada i cesta, kao i prekidi struje, vode i telefonskih veza.
The institute warns that floods of buildings and roads are possible, as well as cuts of electricity, water and telephone connections.
Vozači trebaju biti posebno oprezni, jer će vidljivost biti slabija, a na cestama će biti vode.
Drivers need to be especially careful, because visibility will be weaker and there will be water on the roads.
Stanovnici bi se trebali pripremiti i zaštititi sebe i svoju imovinu.
Residents should prepare and protect themselves and their property.
Hercegovinu je jaka kiša pogodila i ranije ove sedmice, kada su mnoge ulice u Mostaru bile pod vodom.
Heavy rain also hit Herzegovina earlier this week, when many streets in Mostar were under water.
Zavod je dodao da se upozorenje može promijeniti ako se vrijeme promijeni.
The institute added that the warning can change if the weather changes.

title: Izložba „Sedmi sat“ govori o nevidljivom radu žena
The exhibition 'Sedmi sat' talks about women's invisible work
body: U Narodnom pozorištu Sarajevo sinoć je otvorena multimedijalna izložba „Sedmi sat“.
Last night the multimedia exhibition 'Sedmi sat' (The Seventh Hour) was opened at the National Theatre Sarajevo.
Izložba govori o nevidljivom radu žena, ravnopravnosti, dostojanstvu i slobodi.
The exhibition talks about women's invisible work, equality, dignity and freedom.
Otvorena je u vrijeme svjetske kampanje 16 dana aktivizma protiv rodno zasnovanog nasilja.
It was opened during the global campaign 16 Days of Activism against gender-based violence.
Na izložbi su portreti poznatih žena iz BiH, ali i obični predmeti iz kuće, postavljeni kao muzejski eksponati.
The exhibition has portraits of well-known women from BiH, but also ordinary objects from the home, displayed as museum exhibits.
Posjetioci preko QR kodova mogu slušati audio priče.
Visitors can listen to audio stories via QR codes.
Istraživanje koje je pokrenuo UNDP pokazuje da žene u BiH dnevno provedu 6 do 7 sati na neplaćenom kućnom poslu.
Research started by UNDP shows that women in BiH spend 6 to 7 hours a day on unpaid housework.
Zato imaju manje vremena za obrazovanje, karijeru i odmor.
That is why they have less time for education, career and rest.
Izložbu je organizovalo Udruženje Naša Perspektiva, a autorica je Amina Abdičević.
The exhibition was organised by the association Naša Perspektiva, and its author is Amina Abdičević.
Samra Filipović-Hadžiabdić iz Agencije za ravnopravnost spolova rekla je da kućni poslovi nisu samo obaveza žena.
Samra Filipović-Hadžiabdić from the Agency for Gender Equality said that housework is not only a duty of women.
Izložba je otvorena do 3. decembra, a posjetioci trebaju ponijeti mobitel.
The exhibition is open until 3 December, and visitors should bring a mobile phone.

title: 14 zemalja EU traži da AI kompanije plaćaju autorima
14 EU countries want AI companies to pay authors
body: Četrnaest članica Evropske unije traži novi zakon za kompanije koje razvijaju umjetnu inteligenciju.
Fourteen members of the European Union are asking for a new law for companies that develop artificial intelligence.
